responsibility: Implements the core dynamic string abstraction used across the GNU Modula-2 boot libraries, owning allocation, deallocation, concatenation, slicing, copying to and from C strings, case conversion, indexing, and string comparison operations. It also carries internal descriptor and debug metadata for optional leak tracking, garbage marking, cached char* views, and push/pop allocation frames, making it the main managed-string runtime rather than a simple fixed-buffer string utility.
same_name_distinction: This is the full implementation of DynamicStrings, including the private record layouts, allocation and deallocation machinery, cached char* handling, slicing/concatenation code, and optional debug/allocation-frame support. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GDynamicStrings.h, it defines the hidden representation and runtime behavior behind the opaque string type.
